items.title: Leclerc leads Ferrari one-two in first Monza practice
items.author: Alan Baldwin
items.creator: Alan Baldwin
items.summary: Charles Leclerc led Lewis Hamilton in a potent Ferrari one-two after first practice for the team's home Italian Grand Prix at Monza on Friday.
items.body:
Charles Leclerc led Lewis Hamilton in a potent Ferrari one-two after first practice for the team's home Italian Grand Prix at Monza on Friday.
Leclerc's best lap of one minute and 23.008 seconds was 0.173 quicker than Hamilton's fastest effort and just what the tens of thousands of fervent tifosi, packing the venerable 'Temple of Motorsport' with their red shirts and flags, were looking for.
Ferrari, who last won at Monza with Leclerc in 2024, have brought an engine upgrade to the super-fast track in the former royal park outside Milan and looked the clear favourites on the immediate evidence on a hot and sunny afternoon.
Mercedes' George Russell, second in the standings and level on points with Hamilton, was third fastest and 0.304 off the pace.
Liam Lawson, standing in again for the injured Isack Hadjar at Red Bull, was fourth and 0.425 slower than Leclerc while Mercedes' championship leader Kimi Antonelli was fifth.
Antonelli, the first Italian to lead the championship at Monza for 73 years and 59 points clear of Russell after 12 rounds, is set to start at the back of the grid due to an engine change.
McLaren's world champion Lando Norris, winner of the last two races in Hungary and the Netherlands, was sixth fastest with Racing Bulls' Arvid Lindblad seventh and Gabriel Bortoleto eighth for Audi. Franco Colapinto was ninth for Alpine and the team's Estonian reserve Paul Aron completed the top 10.
The session was red-flagged after Cadillac's development driver Colton Herta, standing in for Mexican Sergio Perez to gain experience in the session, came to a halt by the side of the track.
items.raw_description: Charles Leclerc led Lewis Hamilton in a potent Ferrari one-two after first practice for the team's home Italian Grand Prix at Monza on Friday.

items.title: Rubio to visit Colombia, Ecuador and Peru next week
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio will travel to Latin America next week, visiting Ecuador and meeting a pair of newly elected presidents in Colombia and Peru in his first trips to those two countries as America's top diplomat, the State Department said on Friday.
items.body:
U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio will travel to Latin America next week, visiting Ecuador and meeting a pair of newly elected presidents in Colombia and Peru in his first trips to those two countries as America's top diplomat, the State Department said on Friday.
Rubio, who has made four prior trips to Latin America and the Caribbean as secretary of state, will travel Tuesday to Thursday, the State Department said in a statement.
He was scheduled to meet with Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella, who took office on August 7, to discuss U.S. support for Colombia's earthquake response.
A quake struck Colombia three days after de la Espriella was sworn in, killing about 300 people, injuring thousands and causing damage across western and central parts of the country.
Rubio will also meet Peruvian President Keiko Fujimori, who was inaugurated on July 28, and Ecuadoran President Daniel Noboa, whom he previously met on a trip to Ecuador in 2025.
The Latin American trip will also address drug trafficking and trade, the State Department said.
It did not mention neighboring Venezuela, where the United States has become deeply involved since capturing former President Nicolas Maduro in a January military raid and bringing him to the U.S. to face drug-trafficking charges.
items.raw_description: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio will travel to Latin America next week, visiting Ecuador and meeting a pair of newly elected presidents in Colombia and Peru in his first trips to those two countries as America's top diplomat, the State Department said on Friday.

items.title: Muskoka chair maker's tariff woes highlight challenges for mom-and-pop manufacturers
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: A Canadian Muskoka chair maker hit hard by U.S. tariffs is considering moving the bulk of its manufacturing to the United States.
items.body: A Canadian Muskoka chair maker hit hard by U.S. tariffs is considering moving the bulk of its manufacturing to the United States. DFC Woodworks Inc. has been making outdoor wooden patio furniture including Muskoka chairs — also called Adirondack chairs — since 1955. The Kemptville, Ont., company exports about 70 per cent of its furniture to the United States, but those goods are now subject to a steep 50 per cent U.S. duty. DFC Woodworks president François Bruneau says the family-run business is now saddled with a hefty tariff bill and a looming decision over whether to keep absorbing the costs, raise prices and risk seeing U.S. sales fall to zero, or move the majority of its manufacturing south of the border. Fen Hampson, an international affairs professor at Carleton University, says the Muskoka chair maker’s dilemma illustrates the challenges facing many Canadian small and medium-sized enterprises. He says mom-and-pop manufacturers may lack the financial resources, diversified markets and specialized trade expertise that allow larger corporations to weather a trade war. This report by The Canadian Press was first published Sept. 4, 2026. Brett Bundale, The Canadian Press

items.title: Tribunal de apelación de la FIA priva a Gasly del podio de Mónaco y restituye a Hadjar
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El organismo rector de la Fórmula Uno restituyó el viernes a Isack Hadjar, de Red Bull, al tercer puesto en el Gran Premio de Mónaco celebrado el pasado mes de junio y relegó a Pierre Gasly, de Alpine, por segunda vez.
items.body:
El organismo rector de la Fórmula Uno restituyó el viernes a Isack Hadjar, de Red Bull, al tercer puesto en el Gran Premio de Mónaco celebrado el pasado mes de junio y relegó a Pierre Gasly, de Alpine, por segunda vez.
Gasly terminó tercero en pista el 7 de junio, pero fue relegado al séptimo puesto cuando, tras la carrera, se le impusieron dos sanciones de cinco segundos por exceso de velocidad en el pit lane, lo que supuso el ascenso de su compatriota francés Hadjar al tercer puesto.
Esa decisión fue revocada tras un recurso presentado el 12 de junio, al aceptar los comisarios las pruebas aportadas por Alpine —propiedad de Renault— de que se había producido un error en el cronometraje.
El Tribunal Internacional de Apelación de la FIA se reunió entonces el mes pasado para examinar el recurso presentado por McLaren y Red Bull, y el veredicto se hizo público antes del Gran Premio de Italia.

items.title: EU Commissioner Kos cancels trip to Serbia after planned tribute to Mladic
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The European Commissioner for enlargement Marta Kos on Friday canceled a trip to Serbia after a Serbian government plane took the body of former army commander and convicted war criminal Ratko Mladic, who died last week, to Belgrade for what is expected to be a huge funeral.
items.body:
The European Commissioner for enlargement Marta Kos on Friday canceled a trip to Serbia after [USN:L1N44V0PA TEXT:"a Serbian government plane"] took the body of former army commander and convicted war criminal Ratko Mladic, who died last week, to Belgrade for what is expected to be a huge funeral.
"The glorification surrounding his death is incompatible with the values on which the EU path is built. That path requires confronting the past, genuine reconciliation and respecting the victims of war crimes," Kos wrote on X.
"The values that underpin our common future are not negotiable. In this context, I have decided not to proceed with my planned visit to Serbia at this time," added Kos.
Mladic, who was convicted of genocide, crimes against humanity and war crimes committed during Bosnia's 1992-95 war, [USN:S8N42D03Q TEXT:"died"] last week in a U.N. detention facility in The Hague aged 84.
Six Western Balkan countries want to join the EU – Albania, Bosnia, Serbia, Montenegro, North Macedonia and Kosovo – but are at different stages of the accession process.

items.title: Volkswagen trata de sortear la crisis con un pacto de reestructuración y recortes de empleo
items.author: Christoph Steitz, Christina Amann
items.creator: Christoph Steitz, Christina Amann
items.summary: Las acciones de Volkswagen alcanzaron su máximo en 11 semanas después de que el consejo de supervisión del mayor fabricante de automóviles de Europa llegara a un ambicioso acuerdo de reestructuración a última hora del jueves, que se centra en recortes masivos de plantilla y evita un enfrentamiento entre las principales partes interesadas.
items.body:
Las acciones de Volkswagen alcanzaron su máximo en 11 semanas después de que el consejo de supervisión del mayor fabricante de automóviles de Europa llegara a un ambicioso acuerdo de reestructuración a última hora del jueves, que se centra en recortes masivos de plantilla y evita un enfrentamiento entre las principales partes interesadas.
El acuerdo para llevar a cabo la mayor reestructuración en los 89 años de historia del grupo incluye un recorte adicional de 50.000 puestos de trabajo, lo que eleva el total acordado a 100.000, y deja en el aire el futuro de cuatro de sus plantas alemanas.
Volkswagen, al igual que la mayoría de sus competidores europeos, se ve presionada por los dolorosos aranceles de Estados Unidos, la caída de las ventas en China —que antes era su principal fuente de ingresos— y la entrada de agresivos competidores asiáticos en el estancado mercado europeo. Todos estos factores han mermado el margen operativo del grupo, que se situó en el 3,8% en el primer semestre, frente al 7,9% de 2022, su máximo de la última década.
Los accionistas y analistas expresaron su alivio por el hecho de que Volkswagen —con una plantilla de más de 650.000 empleados, una estructura compleja y poderosos grupos de partes interesadas— siga siendo capaz de tomar decisiones de gran alcance en tiempos de crisis.
Las acciones de Volkswagen subían un 5,9% a las 1046 GMT, lo que las convertía en las segundas con mayor subida del índice paneuropeo STOXX 600 (.STOXX) , tras haber alcanzado anteriormente su máximo desde el 18 de junio.
Ingo Speich, de Deka Investment, accionista de Volkswagen, calificó el acuerdo de avance decisivo: "¿Significa esto que Volkswagen está fuera de peligro? Rotundamente no. Ahora viene lo difícil: la ejecución".
Moritz Kronenberger, de Union Investment, pese a acoger con satisfacción el acuerdo, también señaló que ahora la presión recae sobre la dirección para que cumpla: "La pelota está ahora totalmente en el tejado del consejo de administración. Ya no hay excusas".
La dirección, en minoría frente a los sindicatos y al estado federado de Baja Sajonia en el consejo de supervisión, había barajado la posibilidad de convocar una junta de accionistas para imponer sus exigencias, lo que habría supuesto un conflicto sin precedentes entre las partes interesadas del fabricante de automóviles.
Aunque el acuerdo no ofrecía detalles sobre dónde y cuándo se producirían los recortes, el consejero delegado de Volkswagen, Oliver Blume, había declarado anteriormente que la mitad del ahorro tendría que proceder de Alemania, lo que sugiere un recorte de unos 25.000 empleos en sus operaciones nacionales.
Los detalles del programa de recortes de empleo deberán negociarse entre la dirección y los sindicatos, que consiguieron una garantía de empleo para la mayor parte de las operaciones alemanas de Volkswagen hasta 2030 como parte de un anterior paquete de reestructuración en 2024.
"Nos complace que se haya alcanzado este acuerdo", escribieron los analistas de Citi. "No obstante, este acuerdo no modifica automáticamente el entorno competitivo de la UE, las continuas pérdidas de cuota de mercado en China ni las presiones sobre los costos de las materias primas".
Volkswagen buscará alternativas para sus plantas alemanas de Emden, Hannover, Zwickau y Neckarsulm tras el cese progresivo de la producción en la próxima década, lo que podría abarcar diversas opciones, incluida su reconversión bajo una nueva propiedad, según fuentes conocedoras del proceso.
Olaf Lies, presidente del estado de Baja Sajonia —que posee el 20% de los derechos de voto de Volkswagen— dijo que el cierre de las plantas no era un hecho y que se había pedido a la dirección que buscara soluciones alternativas.
"Si tenemos que recortar la capacidad, la conclusión automática no puede ser que lo hagamos en Alemania", dijo a los periodistas, aunque reconoció que el sector automovilístico europeo se encontraba bajo una enorme presión.

items.title: Crudo se encamina a alza semanal por reanudación de hostilidades entre EEUU e Irán
items.author: Anushree Mukherjee
items.creator: Anushree Mukherjee
items.summary: Los precios del petróleo se encaminaban a registrar una subida de más del 6% en la semana, mientras Estados Unidos e Irán reanudaban los enfrentamientos militares en un conflicto que dura ya siete meses, al tiempo que los precios del gasóleo en Estados Unidos alcanzaban un máximo histórico.
items.body:
Los precios del petróleo se encaminaban a registrar una subida de más del 6% en la semana, mientras Estados Unidos e Irán reanudaban los enfrentamientos militares en un conflicto que dura ya siete meses, al tiempo que los precios del gasóleo en Estados Unidos alcanzaban un máximo histórico.
* El alza del crudo, unido a un incremento mucho más pronunciado de los precios de los combustibles, ha impulsado al alza la inflación y los costos de financiación estatales en todo el mundo, y ha intensificado las advertencias de que la economía mundial podría encaminarse hacia un aterrizaje brusco.
* "Todos los sectores de la economía se ven afectados por el gasóleo. Esta es una de las razones por las que el rendimiento de los bonos del Estado en Estados Unidos son tan altos: la expectativa de que la inflación seguirá subiendo", afirmó Claudio Galimberti, economista jefe de Rystad Energy.
* Los precios medios del gasóleo en Estados Unidos alcanzaron máximos históricos, ya que la reanudación de las hostilidades entre Washington y Teherán y los ataques ucranianos contra refinerías rusas aumentaron las interrupciones en el suministro.
* El Gobierno de Estados Unidos ha afirmado que los flujos de petróleo de Oriente Medio han vuelto a niveles casi normales en las últimas semanas, pero los analistas y los servicios de seguimiento de petroleros han señalado que los flujos siguen gravemente afectados.
* A las 1015 GMT, los futuros del Brent bajaban 14 centavos, o un 0,15%, a 95,38 dólares el barril, mientras que los del West Texas Intermediate en Estados Unidos (WTI) restaban 37 centavos, o un 0,41%, a 90,93 dólares.
* Sin embargo, en el conjunto de la semana, el Brent avanzaba un 6,6% y el WTI, un 8,8 %, su mejor desempeño semanal desde el 13 de julio.
* Los ataques estadounidenses de esta semana, que causaron decenas de muertos y heridos, entre ellos civiles iraníes, fueron los enfrentamientos más violentos entre ambos países desde julio.

items.body:
Stock markets in the United Arab Emirates rose on Friday after a business survey showed the country's non-oil private sector expanded at a solid pace in August, driven by stronger output and new business growth.
The S&P Global UAE Purchasing Managers' Index ([USN:ZRN00EJ9Y TEXT:"PMI"]) rose to 55.3 in August from 52.7 in July.
Dubai's main index (.DFMGI) advanced 0.7% in broad-based gains, led by a 2.2% rise in blue-chip developer Emaar Properties (EMAR.DU) , while low-cost carrier Air Arabia (AIRA.DU) added 2.1%.
Air Arabia said it would increase its [USN:FWN44V19V TEXT:"Bangkok"] frequency with four daily flights from Sharjah.
Abu Dhabi's benchmark index (.FTFADGI) advanced 0.5%, helped by a 1.5% gain in the UAE's largest lender First Abu Dhabi Bank (FAB.AD) and a 1.2% rise in Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank (ADCB.AD) .
Aldar Properties (ALDAR.AD) climbed 1.6% after completing mortgage financing on an [USN:FWN44W08O TEXT:"off-plan property"] for its customers through Abu Dhabi Real Estate Centre's (ADREC) newly launched framework.
Oil prices — a key catalyst for the Gulf's financial market — were down 0.45% to $95.11 a barrel by 1139 GMT.

items.title: Dollar deposits push India's forex reserves to fresh record for week ended August 28
items.author: Dharamraj Dhutia
items.creator: Dharamraj Dhutia
items.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves climbed to another record high of $740.80 billion in the week to August 28, central bank data showed on Friday, boosted by heavy inflows from special schemes to attract dollar inflows into the country.
items.body:
India's foreign exchange reserves (INFXR=ECI) climbed to another record high of $740.80 billion in the week to August 28, central bank data showed on Friday, boosted by heavy inflows from special schemes to attract dollar inflows into the country.
India's FX pile has risen for nine straight weeks, jumping by almost $75 billion during this period, with the latest figure comfortably surpassing $729.33 for week ended August 21.
In June, India unveiled discounted hedging facilities for overseas borrowings by state-run firms and banks, and a free-of-cost hedging facility for banks to raise overseas FX deposits.
The Reserve Bank of India received over $136 billion under these schemes between June 5 and August 31, including about $127 billion from non-resident Indian deposits.
For the week, the rupee rose 0.3% against the dollar to 95.3775.
The inflow will give the RBI strong spot FX reserves which can be used to stabilise or strengthen the rupee, HSBC said in a note.
Changes in foreign currency assets, expressed in dollar terms, include the effect of appreciation or depreciation of other currencies held in its reserves.
Foreign exchange reserves include India's Reserve Tranche position in the International Monetary Fund.

items.title: Brewers, with 'unbelievable' Trevor Megill, open series vs. Reds
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Some relievers might hit the figurative wall late in the season, but Milwaukee Brewers closer Trevor Megill appears to be sharper than ever.
items.body:
Some relievers might hit the figurative wall late in the season, but Milwaukee Brewers closer Trevor Megill appears to be sharper than ever.
Megill has not allowed an earned run in his last 14 appearances for Milwaukee, which will open a three-game series against the host Cincinnati Reds on Friday evening.
"Trevor has been unbelievable," Brewers manager Pat Murphy said. "He's been magnificent and he's trusted. Great, great member of that bullpen."
Milwaukee (87-54) is eight games ahead of the second-place Chicago Cubs in the National League Central with 21 games remaining. Chicago salvaged a split of a four-game series between the teams with a 2-1 victory on Thursday.
Cincinnati (67-73) was idle on Thursday after taking two of three games from the San Diego Padres. The Reds are 6 1/2 games behind the Arizona Diamondbacks for the third and final NL wild-card spot.
The MLB-best Brewers boast a stellar bullpen led by Megill, who was named the NL's Reliever of the Month on Thursday. He allowed one unearned run in 11 appearances in August and was 8-for-8 in save opportunities.
"It's always nice (to be honored)," said Megill, who is 2-3 with a 2.19 ERA and 25 saves this season. "Although there's a lot of hard work, a lot of good plays behind me. A lot of wins. August is kind of the dog days of every season. So to stay locked in like that was a good sign."
Milwaukee's bullpen has allowed a total of one run over the last three games covering 10 2/3 innings.
Cincinnati can claim its own award winner in first baseman Sal Stewart, who was named NL Rookie of the Month. Stewart, 22, has 31 homers and leads the majors with 105 RBIs. He hit .304 with eight homers and 21 RBIs in August.
"It's remarkable," Reds closer Emilio Pagan said. "If I had a vote, he's Rookie of the Year. Obviously, I'm biased. And he's getting stronger down the stretch, which is really hard for young players to do. His at-bats seem to be getting better."
Cincinnati will send right-hander Rhett Lowder (6-8, 5.14 ERA) to the mound in the series opener. He allowed three runs over five innings in a 10-8 road victory over the Cubs last Friday.
"They didn't make it easy on me by any means from the jump," Lowder said. "I got behind in some counts early, but credit to them. They were fouling off a ton of tough pitches and not swinging at balls. Made it tough."
Milwaukee's Jake Bauers is 5-for-8 with two homers against Lowder, who is 0-3 with a 6.28 ERA in three career starts vs. Milwaukee -- including 0-2 with a 7.84 ERA in two outings this season.
The Brewers will counter with left-hander Shane Drohan (7-5, 3.75 ERA), who allowed one run over five innings in a 5-3 home win over the Texas Rangers last Saturday.
Drohan walked one and struck out six for his first victory since July 31. In August, he went 1-1 with a 4.84 ERA in five starts covering 22 1/3 innings.
Drohan has not posted a decision in his two career outings vs. Cincinnati, allowing a total of two runs on 11 hits in 10 innings.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Cobre sube por disminución de existencias, apunta a racha alcista de 10 semanas
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El cobre subía el viernes y se encaminaba a registrar su décima subida semanal consecutiva, gracias al apoyo que le proporcionaban la disminución de las existencias fuera de Estados Unidos y la debilidad del dólar.
items.body:
El cobre subía el viernes y se encaminaba a registrar su décima subida semanal consecutiva, gracias al apoyo que le proporcionaban la disminución de las existencias fuera de Estados Unidos y la debilidad del dólar.
* A las 0900 GMT, el contrato de referencia del cobre a tres meses en la Bolsa de Metales de Londres (LME) ganaba un 0,3%, a 14.373 dólares por tonelada, acercándose a su máximo histórico de 14.527,5 dólares.
* El metal se encamina a un alza semanal del 0,5%. Ha subido cada semana desde la que comenzó el 29 de junio, ya que el aumento vertiginoso de las existencias en Estados Unidos , ante la posibilidad de que se apliquen aranceles a las importaciones, está tensando el mercado en el resto del mundo.
* Las importaciones de cobre de Estados Unidos en julio tocaron un pico histórico, mientras que los datos de la Bolsa de Futuros de Shanghái mostraron el viernes que las existencias de cobre cayeron un 13% respecto a la semana pasada, a 63.000 toneladas, el nivel más bajo desde enero de 2024.
* Las existencias de cobre en la LME descendieron en 475 toneladas, y se registraron órdenes de retirada de otras 1.550 toneladas.
* La incertidumbre arancelaria debería seguir respaldando al cobre, aunque los precios, ya elevados, "probablemente limitarán las subidas a corto plazo", señaló en una nota BMI, una unidad de Fitch Solutions.
* El dólar bajaba por menores expectativas de un alza de las tasas de interés tras los comentarios moderados del gobernador de la Reserva Federal Christopher Waller. Un billete verde más barato respalda a las materias primas denominadas en la divisa estadounidense, al hacerlas más asequibles a los compradores con otras divisas.
* En otros metales básicos, el aluminio cedía un 0,5%, a 3.295 dólares; el zinc ganaba un 0,5%, a 3.932,5 dólares; el plomo subía un 0,5%, a 1.912,5 dólares; el níquel avanzaba un 0,2%, a 16.825 dólares; y el estaño restaba un 0,4%, a 54.700 dólares.

items.title: Chinese shipper COSCO denies its vessels spied for Beijing
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: China's state-owned shipping giant COSCO rejected allegations it used concealed equipment on its vessels to collect intelligence for Beijing, calling the claims "totally unfounded" and false.
items.body:
China's state-owned shipping giant COSCO rejected allegations it used concealed equipment on its vessels to collect intelligence for Beijing, calling the claims "totally unfounded" and false.
Reuters on Tuesday [USN:L1N44S0ZA TEXT:"reported"], citing two senior Trump administration officials, that COSCO used the equipment to spy on military communications near the coastlines of target nations including the United States.
The officials, who spoke on condition of anonymity, said COSCO has a decades-long intelligence-collection partnership with Beijing, which allows China to collect communication signals from vessels and aircraft operating across Europe, North America and Asia.
"COSCO SHIPPING has always adhered to market‑oriented operations and compliance practices across all our global businesses," the company said in a statement.
"All communication, navigation, safety and operational equipment installed on our vessels is used solely for legitimate commercial purposes, including navigation safety, ship-to-shore communications and emergency response," it said.
COSCO added that none of the equipment on board its vessels was used for intercepting military communications or gathering intelligence.
Chinese President Xi Jinping is expected to [USN:L4N44R00E TEXT:"visit Washington"] on September 24 for talks with U.S. President Donald Trump, though Beijing has yet to formally confirm the date of the trip.
The summit is expected to focus on a range of sensitive security and trade issues .
China's embassy in Washington has previously said Beijing would never ask any company or individual to "collect or provide data, information or intelligence located abroad against local laws."

items.title: UE envia embarcações ao Canal da Mancha para ajudar a enfrentar “crise imigratória”
items.author: Sudip Kar-Gupta
items.creator: Sudip Kar-Gupta
items.summary: A agência de fronteiras da União Europeia enviará embarcações ao Canal da Mancha e ao Mar do Norte para ajudar nas buscas e no resgate de imigrantes, informaram autoridades nesta sexta-feira, dias após os líderes da França e do Reino Unido se reunirem para discutir a questão da imigração.
items.body:
A agência de fronteiras da União Europeia enviará embarcações ao Canal da Mancha e ao Mar do Norte para ajudar nas buscas e no resgate de imigrantes, informaram autoridades nesta sexta-feira, dias após os líderes da França e do Reino Unido se reunirem para discutir a questão da imigração.
A agência Frontex enviará dois barcos espanhóis de setembro a outubro e, em seguida, um da Lituânia até janeiro, para se juntar às patrulhas francesas, informaram as autoridades responsáveis pela área.
O Canal da Mancha é uma das rotas marítimas mais movimentadas do mundo, e muitos imigrantes já morreram em suas fortes correntes ao tentar atravessar da França para o Reino Unido. Traficantes de pessoas costumam sobrecarregar os botes, deixando-os mal flutuando.
Em agosto, a guarda costeira francesa teve que resgatar 157 pessoas de um barco que pegou fogo.
“Em resposta à crise imigratória em curso no Canal da Mancha, a Frontex enviará embarcações de patrulha para complementar temporariamente os recursos franceses envolvidos em operações de busca e resgate”, dizia um comunicado da Prefeitura Marítima do Canal da Mancha e do Mar do Norte, com sede na França.
A imigração é uma das questões políticas mais polêmicas da Europa, inclusive no Reino Unido, onde o Partido Trabalhista, atualmente no poder, enfrenta o desafio do partido populista Reform UK, que prometeu impedir a chegada de imigrantes em barcos.
O Reino Unido anunciou em abril que pagaria à França até 660 milhões de libras (892,72 milhões de dólares) no âmbito de um acordo de segurança de fronteiras de três anos para coibir as travessias ilegais de imigrantes pelo Canal da Mancha, com parte do financiamento condicionada aos resultados.
No ano passado, ambos os países concordaram com um esquema piloto do tipo “um entra, um sai”, segundo o qual a França aceitará o retorno de pessoas sem documentos que chegam ao Reino Unido em pequenos barcos, em troca de o Reino Unido concordar em aceitar um número igual de requerentes de asilo legítimos com laços familiares britânicos.

items.title: Premiê do Japão vai manter ministra das Finanças em reforma ministerial, dizem fontes
items.author: Tamiyuki Kihara, Makiko Yamazaki
items.creator: Tamiyuki Kihara, Makiko Yamazaki
items.summary: A primeira-ministra do Japão, Sanae Takaichi, vai manter Satsuki Katayama no cargo de ministra das Finanças em uma reforma ministerial que provavelmente ocorrerá ainda este mês, segundo quatro fontes do governo a par do assunto.
items.body:
A primeira-ministra do Japão, Sanae Takaichi, vai manter Satsuki Katayama no cargo de ministra das Finanças em uma reforma ministerial que provavelmente ocorrerá ainda este mês, segundo quatro fontes do governo a par do assunto.
A manutenção no cargo indica uma preferência pela continuidade na política financeira no momento em que o governo conduz negociações com os Estados Unidos sobre câmbio e se prepara para aprovar uma redução do imposto sobre o consumo de alimentos.
Katayama desempenhou um papel fundamental nas negociações com o secretário do Tesouro norte-americano, Scott Bessent, sobre uma rara intervenção conjunta dos EUA e do Japão no mercado do iene no final de julho, uma operação que destacou a estreita cooperação entre os dois países.
“Takaichi valoriza o papel de Katayama na ajuda à realização da intervenção coordenada e sua relação próxima com Bessent”, disse uma das fontes do governo, que se recusaram a se identificar já que o assunto não é de domínio público.
“Retirar Katayama neste momento poderia ser mal interpretado pelos mercados, em um momento em que Bessent intensificou a pressão sobre o Japão”, disse a fonte.
No mês passado, Katayama afirmou que ela e Bessent mantiveram cerca de 10 discussões, incluindo reuniões online, destacando a proximidade entre ambos.
Economistas afirmaram que a substituição de Katayama poderia desestabilizar os mercados caso um sucessor fosse visto como menos preocupado com os riscos decorrentes de um iene mais fraco ou do aumento dos rendimentos dos títulos públicos.
(Reportagem de Leika Kihara, Makiko Yamazaki e Tamiyuki Kihara)

items.title: US job growth expected to rebound in August; unemployment rate forecast steady at 4.1%
items.author: Lucia Mutikani
items.creator: Lucia Mutikani
items.summary: U.S. payrolls growth likely rebounded in August as the drag from local government education reversed, but the anticipated recovery could be limited by job losses related to the termination of Temporary Protected Status for Haitian immigrants.
items.body:
U.S. payrolls growth likely rebounded in August as the drag from local government education reversed, but the anticipated recovery could be limited by job losses related to the termination of Temporary Protected Status for Haitian immigrants.
The Labor Department's closely watched employment report on Friday is expected to paint a picture of a labor market that economists say remains in a "slow hire, slow fire" mode, with the unemployment rate forecast to have held steady at 4.1% last month.
Labor market momentum has decelerated after surging in the spring, partly blamed on the [USN:L6N44V0ZE TEXT:"oil price shock"] and supply [USN:S0N4490BU TEXT:"chain strains"] from the U.S.-led war with Iran. Job growth was hobbled by President Donald Trump's sweeping import tariffs in 2025.
"Businesses felt some of the problems from 2025 were behind, then all of a sudden we get another black swan event that introduces a new set of uncertainties," said Brian Bethune, an economics professor at Boston College. "We saw significant problems with supply chains, oil and fuel prices went up, and that situation has not changed. So that's why the job numbers have dropped from what we saw in the first few months."
Nonfarm payrolls likely increased by 56,000 jobs last month after declining 23,000 in July, according to a Reuters survey of economists. Estimates ranged from as low as another loss of 25,000 jobs to as high as a 121,000 gain.
August payrolls have a tendency to undershoot expectations, with economists blaming a summer seasonal quirk. Local government education employment dropped by 49,600 in July, and a rebound was expected to underpin payrolls in August.
A recovery was also anticipated in the leisure and hospitality industry after losing jobs for two straight months.
Economists, however, cautioned that those gains could be offset by the termination of TPS for [USN:L6N4431EV TEXT:"hundreds of thousands"] of Haitian immigrants, which impacted their work permits.
"We are assuming a 15,000 drag on payrolls from the revocation of Temporary Protected Status for unauthorized Haitian immigrants," said Michael Gapen, chief economist at Morgan Stanley. "It could be much larger. The TPS-affected Haitians account for an estimated 160,000 of national payrolls."
TEMPORARY DRAG FROM TPS TERMINATION The drag, which some economists said could be temporary, would be evident in labor-intensive services sectors like healthcare, mostly care-giving. Some immigrants who lost their TPS could move to other visa categories.
"If payroll employment in August is a bit weaker than we expect, we would not necessarily dismiss weakness as only a result of the TPS expiration, as other data like hiring plans have been soft," said Veronica Clark, an economist at Citigroup.
The Trump administration is cracking down on immigration, through deportations and revocations of TPS, shrinking the labor pool. That has drastically reduced the number of jobs economists say the economy needs to create to keep up with growth in the working-age population. Economists estimate the so-called break-even rate at between zero and 50,000 jobs per month.
Reduced labor supply, also the result of retirements, is keeping the unemployment rate lower, though some economists expected the jobless rate to rise to 4.2% in August, arguing the recent drop in the labor force participation rate was excessive.
"Participation has fallen a full percentage point since the start of the year, a decline that appears outsized relative to broader labor market conditions," said Gregory Daco, chief economist at EY-Parthenon. "The drop mainly reflects reduced population growth, aging demographics and rising retirements, and lower immigration flows."
Barring a shock, August's employment report was unlikely to impact the Federal Reserve's interest rate decision at the U.S. central bank's September 15-16 policy meeting, with the focus on next week's Consumer Price Index report. The labor market is not a source of inflation, with annual wage growth estimated to have slowed to 3.0% last month from 3.2% in July.
Fed Governor [USN:S0N4490CF TEXT:"Christopher Waller"] said at a Reuters NEXT Newsmaker event on Thursday that he was inclined to argue in favor of keeping rates steady this month if upcoming data confirmed inflation pressures were cooling off.
Financial markets saw a 50% chance of a rate hike this month, down from 63.2% on Wednesday, according to CME's FedWatch tool.
Concerns about inflation and lack of forward guidance from the Fed have helped to boost U.S. Treasury yields, which economists said was a problem for the central bank.
Rising yields drove the 30-year fixed mortgage rate to a more than one-year high of 6.71% this week, data from mortgage finance agency Freddie Mac showed on Thursday, which could further undermine a struggling housing market.
"The markets have already dialed in tightening on the yield curve; we got 75 basis points of tightening and that's going to slow down the economy," said Boston College's Bethune. "One of the reasons the long-term rates have been going up is because it's pricing in uncertainty about what the Fed is going to do. That uncertainty is connected with political intimidation."

items.title: Frontex schickt Schiffe zur Rettung von Migranten in den Ärmelkanal
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Die europäische Grenzschutzagentur Frontex unterstützt künftig die Seenotrettung von Migranten im Ärmelkanal und in der Nordsee mit eigenen Schiffen. Dies teilten die zuständigen Behörden am Freitag mit. Demnach sollen von September bis Oktober zwei spanische Schiffe und anschließend bis Januar ein litauisches Schiff die französischen Patrouillen verstärken.
items.body:
Die europäische Grenzschutzagentur Frontex unterstützt künftig die Seenotrettung von Migranten im Ärmelkanal und in der Nordsee mit eigenen Schiffen. Dies teilten die zuständigen Behörden am Freitag mit. Demnach sollen von September bis Oktober zwei spanische Schiffe und anschließend bis Januar ein litauisches Schiff die französischen Patrouillen verstärken.
Die Entscheidung folgt auf ein Treffen von Frankreichs Präsident Emmanuel Macron mit dem britischen Premierminister Andy Burnham, bei dem auch über Migrationsfragen beraten wurde. Frontex wolle mit dem Einsatz die französischen Kapazitäten bei Such- und Rettungseinsätzen vorübergehend ergänzen, hieß es in einer Erklärung der französischen Meerespräfektur für den Ärmelkanal und die Nordsee.
Der Ärmelkanal gehört zu den am stärksten befahrenen Schifffahrtsstraßen der Welt. Wegen der starken Strömung ist die Überquerung von Frankreich nach Großbritannien in oft überladenen Schlauchbooten hochgefährlich. Immer wieder kommen dabei Menschen ums Leben. Im August musste die französische Küstenwache 157 Menschen von einem brennenden Boot retten. Das Thema Migration ist in Europa politisch hochgradig umstritten. In Großbritannien steht die regierende Labour-Partei unter dem Druck der populistischen Partei Reform UK, die ein Ende der Überfahrten mit Migrantenbooten fordert.
Großbritannien hatte im April vereinbart, Frankreich im Rahmen eines dreijährigen Grenzsicherungsabkommens bis zu 780 Millionen Euro (660 Millionen Pfund) zu zahlen, um illegale Überfahrten zu verhindern. Ein Teil der Gelder ist an Erfolge gekoppelt. Im vergangenen Jahr hatten sich beide Länder zudem auf ein Pilotprojekt geeinigt. Demnach nimmt Frankreich Migranten ohne Papiere zurück, die mit kleinen Booten in Großbritannien ankommen. Im Gegenzug nimmt Großbritannien die gleiche Anzahl von Asylsuchenden mit familiären Bindungen auf.

items.title: La fiscalía rumana imputa a Andrew Tate por tráfico de menores y blanqueo de capitales
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La fiscalía rumana imputó oficialmente el viernes al "influencer" de redes sociales Andrew Tate por tráfico de menores, blanqueo de capitales, relaciones sexuales con una menor e intimidación de testigos, y a su hermano Tristan por complicidad, años después de que comenzaran las investigaciones.
items.body:
La fiscalía rumana imputó oficialmente el viernes al "influencer" de redes sociales Andrew Tate por tráfico de menores, blanqueo de capitales, relaciones sexuales con una menor e intimidación de testigos, y a su hermano Tristan por complicidad, años después de que comenzaran las investigaciones.
Los hermanos Tate, exluchadores de "kickboxing" con doble nacionalidad, estadounidense y británica, fueron detenidos en Miami a finales de julio tras solicitar Reino Unido su extradición.
Residentes principalmente en Rumanía desde 2017, son objeto de una investigación penal en ese país por delitos que incluyen la trata de personas desde diciembre de 2022.
La fiscalía rumana dijo que los hermanos Tate captaban a sus víctimas seduciéndolas y fingiendo querer una relación o casarse con ellas, antes de obligarlas a producir contenido pornográfico para un negocio de cámaras web.
Los hermanos han negado todas las acusaciones. "Examinaremos todos los aspectos de (la acusación) con el mismo nivel de rigor e impugnaremos cualquier deficiencia probatoria, procesal o jurídica a través del proceso judicial adecuado", dijo en un comunicado Eugen Vidineac, un abogado rumano de los Tate.
"Nuestros clientes siguen rechazando las acusaciones que se les imputan."
LA FISCALÍA DESCRIBE EL CASO RELACIONADO CON UNA MENOR DE 15 AÑOS Los hermanos Tate permanecen en prisión en EEUU mientras un juez decide sobre la solicitud de su extradición a Reino Unido, donde se los acusa de violación.
El portavoz de la unidad fiscal rumana contra el crimen organizado DIICOT, que investiga a los Tate, dijo que no estaba claro de inmediato si la unidad solicitará su extradición desde Estados Unidos.
Los Tate pueden ser juzgados en ausencia en Rumanía, pero el juicio no comenzará de inmediato. Según la legislación rumana, el auto de acusación se remite a una sala de instrucción, donde un juez examinará el expediente para garantizar su legalidad.
Aunque la ley establece que el juez de la sala de instrucción dispone de 60 días para finalizar el informe, los autos de acusación suelen tardar mucho más tiempo.
La DIICOT afirmó que una de las víctimas de Andrew Tate tenía 15 años cuando él la sedujo en Reino Unido en 2012, antes de trasladarla a Bucarest, la capital rumana, y de recurrir a la violencia física y la intimidación psicológica para explotarla sexualmente, obligándola a producir contenido pornográfico para redes sociales.
Su hermano Tristan fue cómplice, según la unidad, y recurrió a la agresión física para coaccionar a la víctima.
Los fiscales afirmaron que los hermanos se quedaron con 1,25 millones de dólares de los ingresos generados por la víctima a través de videochats, lo que supone aproximadamente el 80% de todas sus ganancias. Añadieron que los hermanos intentaron blanquear los fondos comprando cuatro vehículos de lujo.
Los hermanos ya habían sido imputados en Rumanía por delitos de trata de personas, pero a finales de 2024 el tribunal de apelación de Bucarest devolvió el caso a la fiscalía tras considerar inadmisibles algunas pruebas.
Andrew Tate, que se autodenomina misógino, había declarado anteriormente que se mudó a Rumanía porque allí las fuerzas del orden eran más laxas.
Ambos hermanos han aumentado su número de seguidores, en su mayoría hombres jóvenes, construyéndose una imagen ostentosa y de supermacho en la que conducen vehículos rápidos y salen con mujeres guapas.

Sridhar Vembu says Raghuram Rajan’s ‘Chicago School’ economics can make India like Mexico

The clash between Sridhar Vembu and Raghuram Rajan centres on a fundamental disagreement over how India should build wealth and elevate its workforce to high-paying jobs.

Sagrika Kissu

04 September, 2026 05:14 pm IST

New Delhi: Zoho founder and chief scientist Sridhar Vembu took a swipe at former RBI governor Raghuram Rajan, saying that India cannot complain about low-paying factory jobs while shunning the industrial policy. 

In an interview on September 1, Rajan questioned India’s push to develop the domestic semiconductor industry. He said that most chipsets are “the most easily smuggled thing on Earth,” with China and Russia already smuggling them en masse. Rajan further questioned the “effectiveness of the government’s broader industrial policy of picking sectors for targeted support.”

He further presented Tamil Nadu as an example. 

Show Full Article

“What kind of manufacturing jobs are you getting? They pay in the enterprises that assemble products and all that is not different from the pay the driver gets or a house help gets in Chennai. It’s Rs 20,000 per month. It’s not that great. We need to figure out how we can get better jobs.”

In his response, Vembu wrote a long post on X. His main argument centred on India’s economic model that relies heavily on exporting services while failing to build and own intellectual property (IP).

“High paying jobs, which I agree we need, come from high value addition and that requires that we not only perform the R&D but we also own the IP in India and capture the resulting economic value addition. Only then would pay in even products where India does not have much IP (like the iPhone) would go up,” Vembu wrote on X.

Also read: American prisoners are now calling voters to campaign for Republican candidates

Vembu’s developmental model of India
Vembu went on to illustrate with what he called two “crude examples”. His first example is Nvidia and its gross profit of more than $200 billion a year. 

“…And 24 per cent of Nvidia employees are in India, mostly in R&D. Microsoft has a gross profit of about $230 billion a year and 10 per cent of its R&D staff are in India. India’s economic accounts will not show anywhere near 24 per cent of value added by Nvidia or 10 per cent of value added by Microsoft,” Vembu wrote on X. “If we look at major IP-rich, successful companies in the world, all of them do substantial R&D in India. But only a tiny fraction of economic value added by these companies actually is accounted for in India.”

His central argument revolved around what development model India should follow to become a developed economy. 

“The only mechanism the world has known for a “developing country” (no IP, low value addition) to become a “developed country” (lots of IP and value addition captured locally) is to spur the domestic entrepreneurs and industry to gain the know-how and capability,” he added on X.

Vembu termed Rajan’s arguments as inspired by the “Chicago School” of economic theory. The Chicago School, he says, does not agree with industrial policy.

And then he says that such a school of economic theory would lead us to Mexico’s economic situation but never to Japan or Taiwan or South Korea and now, China. 

“Getting to Japan or Taiwan or South Korea or China requires us to understand “How Asia Works.” China rose from very low wages and now has overtaken nations like Mexico, because China has the know-how and IP and Mexico does not.”

(Edited by Saptak Datta)

items.title: Milei intensifica reivindicações de soberania das Malvinas com sanções sobre petróleo
items.author: Nicolás Misculin, Sarah Young
items.creator: Nicolás Misculin, Sarah Young
items.summary: O presidente argentino, Javier Milei, afirmou que aplicará sanções às empresas petrolíferas que realizarem perfurações nas Ilhas Malvinas, reforçando as reivindicações do país quanto à soberania sobre o território ultramarino britânico.
items.body:
O presidente argentino, Javier Milei, afirmou que aplicará sanções às empresas petrolíferas que realizarem perfurações nas Ilhas Malvinas, reforçando as reivindicações do país quanto à soberania sobre o território ultramarino britânico.
As declarações de Milei, feitas em um discurso nacional televisionado na quinta-feira, ocorreram dias depois que o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, afirmou que estava revendo a posição neutra dos EUA em relação ao remoto arquipélago no Atlântico Sul.
A perspectiva de empresas petrolíferas realizarem exploração nas ilhas — que a Argentina chama de Malvinas — representa uma ameaça urgente aos interesses argentinos, disse Milei, 44 anos depois que seu país foi derrotado pelo Reino Unido em uma guerra pela soberania.
Milei, aliado de Trump, mencionou a possível mudança na posição dos EUA e disse que os “ventos de mudança” favoreciam a reivindicação argentina. Ele afirmou que estava enviando ao Congresso um projeto de lei com o objetivo de fortalecer a resposta da Argentina a violações de sua soberania.
POSIÇÃO BRITÂNICA “INABALÁVEL” O Reino Unido, que controla o território desde 1833, afirmou na sexta-feira que sua posição sobre as ilhas é “inabalável”.
“As ilhas são britânicas e permanecerão assim, pois essa é a posição esmagadora dos habitantes das ilhas”, disse o ministro das Relações Exteriores britânico, Ed Miliband, no X.
“O direito deles à autodeterminação é primordial, fundamentado no direito internacional, e nós o defenderemos com determinação.”
O ministro da Defesa britânico, Wes Streeting, acrescentou que as palavras de Milei refletem “a política interna da Argentina”.
Milei já havia defendido a diplomacia como a melhor forma de buscar a reivindicação da Argentina sobre as Malvinas, mas, com mais perfurações de petróleo previstas para os próximos meses e as repetidas menções de Trump às ilhas, ele agora está adotando um tom mais duro.
Trump disse à GB News na quinta-feira que não tinha certeza se o Reino Unido estaria preparado para lutar pelas ilhas novamente.
“Simplesmente não sei se vocês têm capacidade para fazer isso”, declarou Trump. “A questão das Malvinas é muito interessante porque o seu país não é mais o mesmo de 20 ou 25 anos atrás.”
Uma possível mudança na posição dos EUA em relação às Malvinas foi incluída entre uma série de opções consideradas pelo Pentágono no início deste ano para pressionar aliados da Otan que, em sua opinião, não apoiaram as operações militares dos EUA na guerra contra o Irã.

items.title: La UE envía barcos al Canal de la Mancha para ayudar a hacer frente a la "crisis migratoria"
items.author: Sudip Kar-Gupta
items.creator: Sudip Kar-Gupta
items.summary: La agencia fronteriza de la Unión Europea enviará embarcaciones al Canal de la Mancha y al mar del Norte para ayudar en la búsqueda y el rescate de migrantes, informaron el viernes las autoridades, pocos días después de que los líderes de Francia y Reino Unido se reunieran para tratar el tema de la migración.
items.body:
La agencia fronteriza de la Unión Europea enviará embarcaciones al Canal de la Mancha y al mar del Norte para ayudar en la búsqueda y el rescate de migrantes, informaron el viernes las autoridades, pocos días después de que los líderes de Francia y Reino Unido se reunieran para tratar el tema de la migración.
La agencia Frontex enviará dos embarcaciones españolas entre septiembre y octubre, y posteriormente una de Lituania hasta enero, para sumarse a las patrullas francesas, según las autoridades responsables de la zona.
El Canal de la Mancha es una de las rutas marítimas más transitadas del mundo, y muchos migrantes han perdido la vida en sus fuertes corrientes al intentar cruzar de Francia a Reino Unido. Los traficantes de personas suelen sobrecargar las lanchas neumáticas, lo que hace que apenas se mantengan a flote.
En agosto, los guardacostas franceses tuvieron que rescatar a 157 personas de una embarcación que se incendió.
"En respuesta a la actual crisis migratoria en el Canal de la Mancha, Frontex desplegará buques patrulleros para complementar temporalmente los recursos franceses que participan en operaciones de búsqueda y rescate", según un comunicado de la Prefectura Marítima del Canal de la Mancha y del mar del Norte, con sede en Francia.
La migración es uno de los temas políticos más polémicos de Europa, incluso en Reino Unido, donde el Partido Laborista, actualmente en el poder, se enfrenta al desafío del partido populista Reform UK, que se ha comprometido a impedir la llegada de migrantes en embarcaciones.
Reino Unido anunció en abril que pagaría a Francia hasta 660 millones de libras esterlinas (892,72 millones de dólares) en el marco de un acuerdo de seguridad fronteriza de tres años para frenar los cruces ilegales de migrantes por el Canal de la Mancha, estando parte de la financiación supeditada a los resultados.
El año pasado, ambos países acordaron un programa piloto de "uno entra, uno sale", en virtud del cual Francia aceptará el retorno de personas indocumentadas que lleguen a Reino Unido en pequeñas embarcaciones, a cambio de que Reino Unido se comprometa a acoger a un número equivalente de solicitantes de asilo legítimos con vínculos familiares en el país.
(1 dólar = 0,7393 libras)

items.title: ノルウェー政府系ファンド、米国債を大幅削減方針　資産構成を変更
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Iain Withers　Tommy Reggiori Wilkes

[ロンドン ４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Iain Withers　Tommy Reggiori Wilkes

[ロンドン ４日 ロイター] - ノルウェー政府系ファンドの運用機関が、リターン改善に向けた債券投資の幅広い見直しの一環として、米国債への投資を大幅に削減する案を提示した。今週公表された書簡で明らかになった。

書簡によると、２兆３０００億ドル規模の政府年金基金を運用するノルウェー中央銀行の投資管理部門（ＮＢＩＭ）は、債券ベンチマークインデックスでの国債ウエートを現在の７０％から５０％に引き下げることを提言した。最大の保有資産である米国債が最も大きく削減される。

ロイターの試算によると、６月末時点で約２１５０億ドルとなっている米国債保有は変更により８００億ドル近く削減される。

ノルウェー政府系ファンドは、世界の全上場企業の平均１．５％を保有している。

＜変更は段階的に実施＞

債券投資戦略に関するノルウェー財務省からの質問に応じて提案は示された。ＮＢＩＭは財務省の回答を待つとした上で、市場への影響と取引コストを抑えるため、いかなる変更も段階的に実施する。「国債比率５０％は、金融市場が混乱する局面を含め流動性ニーズを満たすのに十分」としている。

同ファンドは別の書簡で、非上場資産への投資拡大を検討することも提案した。これは少数の米ハイテク企業の株価が急騰する中、株式ポートフォリオで高まっている集中リスクを低減する狙いもある。

現在の運用方針の下で、同ファンドは非上場の不動産や再生可能エネルギー資産を保有できるが、非上場投資の比率は同種のファンドと比べて低い。

＜米国債の削減＞

ＮＢＩＭによると、債券インデックスの最大の変更は、住宅ローン担保証券（ＭＢＳ）など国債以外の債券への投資を拡大することだ。これにより分散やリスクプレミアムへの対応を進める。

ＮＢＩＭの広報担当者は、米ドル全体のエクスポージャーは約５０％で変わらないとした上で、「変わるのはドル資産の構成だ」と述べた。

書簡によると、提案により債券インデックスの米国債ウエートは３４．１％から２１．９％に低下する。

ユーロ圏債券への配分は１６．８％から１４．１％へ低下。日本国債への配分は４．６％から７．４％に上昇する一方、英国への配分は４．２％で変わらない。これらの変更によりインデックスが市場全体の構成比により近づくとしている。

米国債のエクスポージャーは低下する一方、国債以外の米債券への配分は１６．２％から２７．６％に拡大する。これにより債券インデックスでの米ドルのウエートは５２．９％から５２．５％へとわずかに低下する。

items.title: China may challenge Brazil in chicken export markets within a decade, Rabobank says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: China could emerge as a competitor to Brazil in key chicken meat markets including the Middle East within the next decade after becoming a net exporter in 2025, Rabobank analyst Chenjun Pan told Reuters.
items.body:
China could emerge as a competitor to Brazil in key chicken meat markets including the Middle East within the next decade after becoming a net exporter in 2025, Rabobank analyst Chenjun Pan told Reuters.
China is currently Brazil's top chicken export destination, but surging domestic production is generating exportable surpluses of cuts such as breast meat, which Chinese consumers rarely eat.
The world's fifth-largest chicken exporter in 2025, China shipped just over 1 million metric tons, according to Brazilian meat lobby ABPA.
Brazil, the top exporter, shipped 5.3 million tons.
Pan said potential competition in the Middle East, Asia and Africa could emerge within the next decade.
Chinese chicken production grew about 7% in 2025 and more than 9% year-on-year in the first half of 2026, Rabobank said.
Chinese chicken export destinations include Russia, Hong Kong, North Korea and Middle Eastern countries.
China does not compete with Brazil in the European Union, Japan or South Korea, where chicken vaccinated against bird flu is not accepted.
Beijing has promoted chicken production to reduce reliance on pork, following the African swine fever crisis of 2019–2021.

items.title: Tigers intend to keep fighting in doubleheader vs. Guardians
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: This weekend will mark the Detroit Tigers' biggest test yet. If they are to extend their streak of postseason appearances to three, they need to fare well in their four-game series at the Cleveland Guardians.
items.body:
This weekend will mark the Detroit Tigers' biggest test yet. If they are to extend their streak of postseason appearances to three, they need to fare well in their four-game series at the Cleveland Guardians.
The set will begin with a split doubleheader on Friday.
Tigers right-hander Keider Montero (9-8, 3.24 ERA) will start the afternoon game against Guardians left-hander Logan Allen (0-0, 3.77).
Detroit's Andrew Sears (0-1, 6.75) will work the nightcap in a battle of left-handers against Cleveland's Foster Griffin (15-4, 3.21).
"This has been a really hard stretch and very much a roller-coaster season," Tigers manager A.J. Hinch said. "I know in the big scheme of things, there is a lot of frustration around this team, but we're not going to quit."
Cleveland (70-70) sits in the third American League wild-card position, one-half game ahead of the Toronto Blue Jays and Texas Rangers and 5 1/2 games in front of Detroit (64-75).
The Tigers survived their biggest gut-check of the year on Wednesday, pulling out an 11-6 victory in 12 innings at the Minnesota Twins. Minnesota had won the previous two games by a combined 26-3 score and rallied from three down in the eighth on Wednesday.
Detroit fixture Spencer Torkelson saved the day with a two-run homer in the 12th inning, when the visitors scored five runs off Tommy Nance.
"The way the last couple of weeks have gone, we very easily could have said, 'All right, we're done. It's not our night,'" Torkelson said. "This is one of my favorite wins in a long time because of how proud I am of the way we stayed in the fight."
Montero had alternated wins and losses since July 22, going 3-3 with a 3.29 ERA. He has made two starts against the Guardians this year after facing them for the initial time in 2025, compiling a 1-0 record and 1.53 ERA over 17 2/3 innings and three games.
Sears made his major league debut with an Aug. 23 loss at the Kansas City Royals, but this marks his first start and appearance vs. Cleveland.
The Guardians have lost four of the first six games on their 10-game homestand, dropping two of three to both the Royals and Blue Jays. After leading the Central Division for most of the first three months, Cleveland now is fighting to hang onto the last playoff position.
Guardians rookie Travis Bazzana made a splash by hitting .311 in his first month in the big leagues, leading to his All-Star selection via the players' ballot.
Much like the entire Cleveland team, Bazzana has slumped with a .204 average since June 1. He also has been shaky at second base, making two glaring mistakes in the last two games.
"When you're going through your first season and you want to be great for your teammates and you go through a stretch where it's been a little bit tough, you're going to wear it," manager Stephen Vogt said. "But we know Travis is a really good player and he's going to bounce out of it."
Bazzana is hitless in 12 at-bats this homestand and hasn't made himself available to reporters. The boo-birds have begun to surface, as his season home batting average is .212.
"We've talked about Travis a lot this year," Vogt said. "He came here with expectations and both on himself and from the outside. It's not easy."
Griffin was a surprising trade-deadline acquisition last month, coming from the Washington Nationals after making the National League All-Star team. He is 3-1 with a 3.96 ERA with Cleveland, winning three straight decisions.
In two career games against the Tigers, he is 2-0 with a 1.35 ERA, including a five-inning start on Aug. 12 at Detroit.
Allen has worked out of the bullpen in his last four appearances, most recently starting on July 18 with a 3 1/3-inning effort against the Pittsburgh Pirates to begin his latest stint in the majors.
He has been shelled by the Tigers in four career games, all starts, going 0-3 with a 7.00 ERA while giving up five homers in 18 innings.
--Field Level Media

items.title: India's NSE targets listing in week of September 21 after IPO clearance, sources say
items.author: Jayshree Pyasi, Vivek M
items.creator: Jayshree Pyasi, Vivek M
items.summary: India's National Stock Exchange is planning to list in the week starting September 21, two sources familiar with the matter said, after the markets regulator cleared its long-awaited IPO on Friday.
items.body:
India's National Stock Exchange is planning to list in the week starting September 21, two sources familiar with the matter said, after the markets regulator cleared its long-awaited IPO on Friday.
The exchange is expected to begin book-building, a process to gauge investor demand and determine the IPO price, on September 11, with the price band likely to be announced on September 15, the sources said, declining to be named as they were not authorised to speak to the media.
NSE did not immediately respond to a Reuters' request for comment.
Its share sale could rank among India's biggest-ever, alongside billionaire Mukesh Ambani's [USN:L4N44P0TT TEXT:"Jio"]. NSE has been valued at about $55 billion in the unlisted market, according to Reuters estimates, potentially placing it among the country's 10 most valuable companies by market capitalisation.
NSE dominates trading in India's equity derivatives market and is the world's most active derivatives exchange by contracts traded. The exchange operates India's benchmark Nifty 50 index (.NSEI) .
"Post listing NSE will be top 10 among India's largest companies in terms of market cap, which will garner huge interest from the market," said Deven Choksey, managing director of fund and wealth manager DRChoksey FinServ.
"At an expected price-to-earnings valuation of around 35 times, the IPO would provide investors with headroom (for gains) after listing," Choksey said.
CROWDED SPACE NSE's listing comes at a time when India's primary market is set for a record six IPOs on a single day next week, as companies hasten fundraising plans after a sluggish start to 2026 amid the U.S.-Iran war.
It was unclear whether the NSE IPO would ease or intensify competition for investor attention, Arun Kejriwal, founder of Kejriwal Research and Investment Services, said.
"I'm not sure whether NSE hitting the market at such a time will add to the pressure or reduce the pressure."
NSE's proposed offering will be an offer for sale by existing shareholders, meaning NSE itself will not receive proceeds from the issue.
Despite a recent clampdown on [USN:L4N44H17K TEXT:"derivatives trading"] by retail investors, India's capital markets penetration remains low compared with other major economies.
The Securities and Exchange Board of India issued observations on NSE's draft prospectus, a key regulatory milestone that allows companies to proceed with the next steps towards launching share sales.
NSE filed its draft red herring prospectus with SEBI on June 17, reviving a listing plan that had been held up since 2016 by regulatory scrutiny and legacy legal issues.
NSE's listing ambitions had been delayed by investigations related to its co-location and dark-fibre facilities, as well as other regulatory matters. The clearance follows NSE's settlement of past lapses with SEBI, removing a major obstacle.
Rival BSE (BSEL.NS) , which went public in 2017, has seen its shares surge 28-fold.
items.raw_description: India's National Stock Exchange is planning to list in the week starting September 21, two sources familiar with the matter said, after the markets regulator cleared its long-awaited IPO on Friday.

items.title: Exportadora de carne de frango, China será competidora do Brasil, avalia Rabobank
items.author: Roberto Samora
items.creator: Roberto Samora
items.summary: Com uma produção crescente de carne de frango, a China deverá ampliar sua participação nas exportações globais e acirrar a competição com o Brasil na próxima década em mercados importantes como o Oriente Médio, avaliou uma especialista chinesa do Rabobank no setor de carnes.
items.body:
Com uma produção crescente de carne de frango, a China deverá ampliar sua participação nas exportações globais e acirrar a competição com o Brasil na próxima década em mercados importantes como o Oriente Médio, avaliou uma especialista chinesa do Rabobank no setor de carnes.
Embora seja atualmente o principal destino da carne de frango brasileira, a China se tornou exportadora líquida da proteína desde 2025, vendendo excedentes de cortes menos consumidos no mercado doméstico, como o peito.
E há espaço para crescer mais, disse Chenjun Pan, em entrevista à Reuters, durante sua passagem pelo escritório do Rabobank em São Paulo.
"Acredito que, potencialmente -- não agora, mas talvez na próxima década --, possa haver alguma competição no Oriente Médio, na Ásia e na África" da carne de frango chinesa com a brasileira, disse a especialista.
A China, o segundo produtor global atrás dos Estados Unidos, foi o quinto maior exportador no ano passado, segundo um relatório anual publicado pela associação da indústria brasileira, a ABPA.
As exportações chinesas somaram pouco mais de 1 milhão de toneladas em 2025, enquanto o Brasil, maior exportador global, embarcou um recorde de 5,3 milhões de toneladas para o exterior.
"A China já exporta carne de frango há muitos anos. Era principalmente carne processada. Mas, recentemente, o país começou a exportar grandes quantidades de carne in natura, como o peito de frango... esse segmento está crescendo rapidamente", disse Pan.
Com a produção crescendo a uma taxa próxima de 10%, a China passou a gerar excedentes exportáveis, uma vez que o consumidor chinês demanda mais pés e asas -- produtos fortemente exportados pelo Brasil para lá --, mas menos cortes como o peito de frango, que tem maior demanda no exterior.
"Os chineses não gostam de carne de peito por uma questão de hábito alimentar. Eles gostam de comer asas e pés", disse Pan.
As exportações chinesas incluem destinos como a Rússia, Hong Kong, Coreia do Norte e países do Oriente Médio.
Contudo, a China não compete com o Brasil em destinos da União Europeia, Japão e Coreia do Sul, uma vez que esses países não aceitam carne de frangos vacinados contra a gripe aviária, uma estratégia chinesa para reduzir impactos do vírus mortal.
OPORTUNIDADE NA CRISE No primeiro semestre, a produção de carne de frango da China cresceu mais de 9% em relação ao mesmo período do ano passado, após ter avançado cerca de 7% em 2025, segundo a analista do Rabobank.
"Então, está muito, muito forte o crescimento", afirmou. "O aumento da demanda é forte, mas não tão forte quanto o crescimento da produção", pontuou.
A produção de carne de frango da China ganhou mais impulso nos últimos anos como parte da estratégia do governo para reduzir a dependência da carne suína -- os chineses são os maiores consumidores globais dessa proteína.
Durante a crise da peste suína africana, entre 2019 e 2021, houve escassez de carne de porco e os preços dispararam, deixando também as cotações da proteína de frango muito altas.
"Isso atraiu investimentos, expandindo a capacidade de produção de frango chinesa", disse a especialista, acrescentando que o movimento colaborou para a fatia do frango no mercado chinês de carnes ter avançado para 28%.
A estratégia também leva em conta que a produção de frango exige menos milho e farelo de soja por unidade de proteína produzida do que a suinocultura, em um momento em que Pequim busca reduzir sua dependência das importações de grãos para ração.
Segundo Pan, a migração do consumo para proteínas mais eficientes em termos de uso de ração, como o frango, aliada à expectativa de retração da produção de carne suína, tende a limitar o crescimento da demanda chinesa por soja.
Por outro lado, Pan considera que a demanda chinesa por carne bovina tem potencial de crescer no futuro, ainda que no momento esse mercado sofra com restrições da oferta, que incluem tarifas de importação extracota mais altas para o Brasil e outros países.
Ela ressaltou, contudo, que as tarifas mais elevadas devem permanecer até 2028, e que o Brasil poderia ter mais oportunidades depois disso, já que "a demanda na China está migrando de commodities para produtos de valor agregado".

items.title: Xi llevará una gran delegación de directores ejecutivos en su visita a EEUU, según fuentes
items.author: Laurie Chen, Eduardo Baptista
items.creator: Laurie Chen, Eduardo Baptista
items.summary: El presidente chino, Xi Jinping, está preparando una amplia delegación empresarial para que le acompañe en su visita a Washington, según dos fuentes, una medida inusual teniendo en cuenta el escepticismo de Estados Unidos hacia la inversión china y las tensas relaciones de Pekín con la empresa privada.
items.body:
El presidente chino, Xi Jinping, está preparando una amplia delegación empresarial para que le acompañe en su visita a Washington, según dos fuentes, una medida inusual teniendo en cuenta el escepticismo de Estados Unidos hacia la inversión china y las tensas relaciones de Pekín con la empresa privada.
Xi rara vez viaja al extranjero con ejecutivos de empresas, muchos de los cuales cayeron en desgracia tras las medidas reguladoras de Pekín contra los sectores tecnológico, educativo e inmobiliario que comenzaron en 2020.
La delegación empresarial prevista para la cumbre del 24 de septiembre no se había dado a conocer hasta ahora. Reuters no pudo determinar qué ejecutivos formarán parte de la delegación.
Esta medida tiene como objetivo, en parte, mostrar la voluntad de China de apoyar la inversión y los lazos comerciales con EEUU, al tiempo que ofrece a la Casa Blanca algunos posibles beneficios económicos de cara a las elecciones de mitad de mandato, según dijo una de las fuentes familiarizadas con las conversaciones.
En los últimos años, las empresas chinas se han enfrentado a un escrutinio cada vez mayor de sus inversiones y operaciones comerciales en Estados Unidos.
Washington ha impuesto un arancel del 100% a los vehículos eléctricos chinos importados, ha prohibido las importaciones de drones, "routers" y robots extranjeros, y ha obligado a la desinversión de las operaciones de TikTok en EEUU. También ha incluido a las principales empresas tecnológicas chinas en la Lista de Entidades (Entity List), que recoge a las empresas u organizaciones consideradas una amenaza para la seguridad nacional, así como en una lista negra del Pentágono.
La última vez que Xi llevó una nutrida delegación empresarial a EEUU fue en 2015, entre los que se encontraban el fundador de Alibaba (9988.HK) , Jack Ma; el fundador de Tencent (0700.HK) , Pony Ma; y ejecutivos de bancos chinos y empresas estatales.
Durante esa visita, China firmó un acuerdo por valor de 38.000 millones de dólares para la adquisición de 300 aviones Boeing (BA.N) , y Xi se reunió con directivos del sector tecnológico estadounidense, entre ellos el director ejecutivo de Apple (AAPL.O) , Tim Cook; el director ejecutivo de Meta (META.O) , Mark Zuckerberg; y el fundador de Amazon (AMZN.O) , Jeff Bezos.
Por el contrario, el presidente de EEUU, Donald Trump, ha viajado a China con amplias delegaciones de ejecutivos estadounidenses —entre otras, en sus visitas de 2017 y de mayo de este año— con el objetivo de conseguir un mayor acceso a los mercados chinos.
UNA GRAN DELEGACIÓN EMPRESARIAL ESTADOUNIDENSE VISITÓ PEKÍN En mayo, Trump se llevó a China a 18 ejecutivos estadounidenses, entre ellos el director ejecutivo de Nvidia (NVDA.O) , Jensen Huang, y Elon Musk, según indicaron las fuentes.
"Mi impresión es que los chinos (…) van a dar más importancia al papel de estos empresarios al incluirlos en la delegación", dijo Scott Kennedy, experto en negocios chinos del Centro de Estudios Estratégicos e Internacionales.
La participación de los ejecutivos podría resultar "realmente valiosa", añadió.
Kennedy comparó el enfoque chino con la organización de la delegación estadounidense de mayo, que, según él, se formó con poca antelación y cuyos ejecutivos fueron "más observadores pasivos que participantes activos".
El Tesoro de EEUU, la Oficina del Representante Comercial de EEUU y el Departamento de Estado no respondieron a las solicitudes de comentarios de Reuters. Los ministerios de Asuntos Exteriores y de Comercio de China no respondieron de inmediato a las solicitudes de comentarios.
CUMBRE SIMBÓLICA Ambos países anunciaron en mayo mecanismos formales para gestionar las relaciones comerciales y de inversión. Sin embargo, tres fuentes independientes informadas sobre el asunto señalaron que es poco probable que la Junta de Inversiones genere resultados significativos en la cumbre debido al difícil entorno que existe en EEUU para la inversión china.
Las expectativas respecto a la cumbre siguen siendo modestas, con perspectivas limitadas de avances importantes, según las fuentes.
Pekín y Washington también siguen sin ponerse de acuerdo sobre qué productos deberían considerarse "no sensibles" en el marco de la Junta de Comercio, según las tres fuentes.
Se está debatiendo la inclusión de unas diez categorías de productos "no sensibles", pero esto podría cambiar a medida que se acerque la cumbre, según una de las fuentes.
JUNTA DE COMERCIO Llegar a un acuerdo sobre la Junta de Comercio es una de las principales prioridades de Estados Unidos para la cumbre, junto con la obtención de más licencias de exportación de tierras raras para las empresas estadounidenses, según las fuentes.
Un representante estadounidense anónimo dijo que el Gobierno sigue presionando a sus homólogos chinos para que aborden el incumplimiento por parte de China del acuerdo anunciado en Busan en octubre, que garantizó una tregua comercial de un año que suspendió temporalmente algunos controles a la exportación y aranceles, así como otras cuestiones bilaterales.
Pekín ha presionado para obtener una mayor reducción arancelaria. El Ministerio de Comercio chino afirmó en julio que ambas partes estaban estudiando reducciones arancelarias recíprocas que abarcarían productos por valor de 30.000 millones de dólares.
Aunque en febrero la Corte Suprema de EEUU anuló los aranceles relacionados con China impuestos en virtud de la Ley de Poderes Económicos de Emergencia Internacional, Washington introdujo posteriormente un arancel global del 10% sobre las importaciones.
El representante comercial de EEUU, Jamieson Greer, dijo el jueves que ambos países harán "algunos anuncios sobre agricultura y barreras no arancelarias" durante la cumbre, sin dar más detalles.
El secretario del Tesoro de EEUU, Scott Bessent, Greer y el vice primer ministro chino He Lifeng se reunirán a principios de septiembre para debatir los posibles resultados de la cumbre, según informaron cuatro fuentes a Reuters. Reuters no pudo determinar la fecha ni el lugar exactos de las conversaciones.

items.title: Tata Chemicals Kenya ‘exit’: What is the Magadi issue behind Ruto's directive? Company responds
items.author: Garvit Bhirani
items.summary: Tata Chemicals has been ordered to withdraw from Kenya by President Ruto, who criticised the company for insufficient local value creation. The government plans to engage new investors to enhance local manufacturing and job creation while Tata said that it is ‘compliant with applicable regulations’.
items.body: The Magadi dispute between Tata Chemicals and the Kenyan government escalated in July, when Nairobi ordered the company’s subsidiary to suspend operations at the Magadi Soda plant and halt soda ash exports. The standoff has since intensified, with President William Ruto now directing the company to exit Kenya.Tata Chemicals on Friday stated it respects the Kenyan government’s authority and will continue engaging with officials through established legal and regulatory channels to address the pending issues.Ruto accused the company of shipping soda ash abroad without adequately developing local processing capacity to produce products such as glass and chemicals. He told the firm to “pack up and leave” as the government seeks to change how the mineral resources are utilised, according to Bloomberg.The Kenyan government, according to Ruto, has already identified two new investors to take over the operations. The move is aimed at increasing local manufacturing, creating jobs and attracting greater investment into the country."That TATA company ... had that contract for 100 years. They have not built anything in Kajiado, they have not built any factory in Kajiado," Ruto said, adding, “We have said we will bring a new company and ... they should put a big glass company here in Kajiado. And another company to make chemicals here in Kajiado. Are we slaves to other people?”The facility is located in Magadi, a township in Kajiado County in southern Kenya, where Ruto visited.The Tata Group company runs its soda ash operations at Lake Magadi, roughly 120 km (75 miles) southwest of Nairobi. It produces more than 350,000 tonnes of soda ash each year, supplying overseas markets such as India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East and several African countries, according to BBC.It is among Kenya’s largest mineral exporters. At Lake Magadi, the company mines trona and converts it into soda ash. The material is widely used in glass manufacturing and also serves as an input for detergents, chemicals, water treatment, textiles and paper, according to Tata Chemicals’ website.Kenya ranks as the world’s fourth-largest producer of natural soda ash, or sodium carbonate. According to the US Geological Survey, the country contributes around 1% of global output.What Tata Chemicals saidTata Chemicals said it had provided the Kenyan government with all the information and documents requested. The company reiterated that it is "compliant with applicable regulations" and is awaiting the government’s review of its response.The company noted it remains focused on the welfare of its employees, the Magadi community and other stakeholders, while supporting Kenya’s broader economic development.“Since 2005, when Tata Chemicals acquired the Magadi plant, it has played an important role in the Kenyan economy and continues to be an integral part of our business,” Tata Chemicals said.It added, “Our priority continues to be the well-being of our employees, the Magadi community, our stakeholders in Kenya and continued economic development of Kenya."
